description: :house_with_garden: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.

latest_release.body:
- Bump midea-local to v15.1.0 ([@chemelli74] - [#191702]) ([midea docs]) (dependency)
- Fix UniFi options flow for unloaded entries ([@Kane610] - [#191684]) ([unifi docs])
- indi_allsky: Bump aioindiallsky to 0.1.8 ([@TN-1] - [#191797]) ([indi_allsky docs]) (dependency)
- Bump iometer to 1.0.3 ([@torben-iometer] - [#191801]) ([iometer docs]) (dependency)
- Bump rapt-ble to 2.0.1 ([@sairon] - [#191777]) ([rapt_ble docs]) (dependency)
- Bump reolink_aio to 0.23.0 ([@starkillerOG] - [#191779]) ([reolink docs]) (dependency)
- Bump velbus-aio to 2026.11.3 ([@cereal2nd] - [#191783]) ([velbus docs]) (dependency)
- Don't subscribe to ONVIF webhook notifications without a URL ([@MartinHjelmare] - [#191846]) ([onvif docs])
- Redact the Solar-Log password in diagnostics ([@Dhairya-007] - [#191582]) ([solarlog docs])
- Fix Hue migration failing for multi-channel Zigbee devices ([@jaeminbird] - [#191719]) ([hue docs])
- Bump trmnl to 0.2.0 ([@joostlek] - [#191919]) ([trmnl docs]) (dependency)
- Fix webostv going unavailable when the TV resets the connection ([@thecode] - [#191905]) ([webostv docs])
- Fix Axis camera basic auth support ([@Kane610] - [#191972]) ([axis docs])
- Bump arcam-fmj to 3.1.2 ([@elupus] - [#191963]) ([arcam_fmj docs]) (dependency)
- Bump aiowebostv to 1.0.2 ([@thecode] - [#192042]) ([webostv docs]) (dependency)
- Apply the Tedee auth failure grace period during setup ([@zweckj] - [#192058]) ([tedee docs])
- Add priority sensor to myuplink SMO20 devices ([@astrandb] - [#192061]) ([myuplink docs])
- Bump egauge-async to 0.6.0 to support virtual registers ([@altontoth] - [#192004]) ([egauge docs]) (dependency)
- Fix Reolink playback for NVRs and Hubs ([@starkillerOG] - [#191946]) ([reolink docs])
- Add translations for humidifier modes in Midea ([@chemelli74] - [#191844]) ([midea docs])
- Bump aiowebostv to 1.1.0 ([@thecode] - [#192121]) ([webostv docs]) (dependency)
- Reject input_text.set_value values that violate the pattern ([@surajvelip] - [#192100]) ([input_text docs])
- Fix SmartThings Do Not Disturb time entities with missing value ([@joostlek] - [#192071]) ([smartthings docs])
- Hide webOS TV volume set when the TV reports it is not supported ([@thecode] - [#192203]) ([webostv docs])
- fix FRITZ!OS version parsing ([@mib1185] - [#192332]) ([fritz docs])
- Fix diagnostics for (older) FRITZ!Repeaters ([@mib1185] - [#192328]) ([fritz docs])
- Update frontend to 20261028.6 ([@bramkragten] - [#192530]) ([frontend docs]) (dependency)
- Bump Todoist SDK to fix project view style deserialization ([@nats12] - [#192431]) ([todoist docs]) (dependency)
- Fix MQTT reload loop on duplicate unique ID of a disabled entity ([@jbouwh] - [#192176]) ([mqtt docs])
- Fix MQTT unsubscribe callback after the MQTT entry is reloaded ([@jbouwh] - [#192440]) ([mqtt docs])
- Prevent voice event from replaying last command after reload in Alexa Devices ([@chemelli74] - [#192463]) ([alexa_devices docs])
- Redact account identifiers in Alexa Devices ([@chemelli74] - [#192518]) ([alexa_devices docs])
- Handle Proxmox HTTP skipping nodes that return 596 ([@Kevin-Tamayose] - [#190487]) ([proxmoxve docs])
- Bump midea-local to 15.2.0 ([@chemelli74] - [#192648]) ([midea docs]) (dependency)
- Bump axis to 75 ([@Kane610] - [#192662]) ([axis docs])
- Set ephember iot_class to cloud_polling ([@roberty99] - [#192811]) ([ephember docs])
- Respect device volume support in Spotify media player ([@FrancescoEsk] - [#192778]) ([spotify docs])
- ViCare: use temperature delta (K) for heating curve shift and dhw hysteresis ([@plata] - [#191179]) ([vicare docs])
- Update LG webOS TV device info when the TV connects ([@thecode] - [#192823]) ([webostv docs])
- Fix dropping of selected regions in NINA config flow ([@Shivansh-S17] - [#192587]) ([nina docs])
- Bump airOS fixing firmware install ([@CoMPaTech] - [#192777]) ([airos docs])
- Upgrade aioftp to 0.28.3 (security) ([@scop] - [#192780]) ([yi docs]) (dependency)
- Igno
